## Description

30-minute reception training (register quick/full, duplicates, book/reschedule/cancel/no-show, walk-in, check-in, board, TV, reminders, what reception cannot see). One-page desk card per country (A4, en + local language). Support channel (WhatsApp/phone) with a named contact and hours; escalation path for security/privacy incidents.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Training delivered to every receptionist at both clinics, attendance recorded.
- [ ] **AC2.** Desk card printed and available at each desk, covering the top 8 tasks and who to call.
- [ ] **AC3.** Support contact, hours and escalation are communicated in writing and listed in the R1 release notes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
